whyItMatters: The corrective lenses restriction is the most commonly held restriction in the state, and it is not a footnote — driving without the glasses it requires is operating in violation of a restriction, and it is also an automatic failure if it happens on the road test.
example: You read 20/60 uncorrected and 20/30 with your contacts. You pass, and your licence carries the corrective lenses code. From then on, driving without the contacts in is a restriction violation, not a lapse of memory.

title: The Knowledge Examination

rules.text: The examination has at least 25 questions drawn from the basic knowledge, traffic rules, regulations, signs and markings in the handbook.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The knowledge examination has at least 25 questions based on the basic knowledge, traffic rules, regulations, signs, and markings found in the  handbook.

rules.text: You must answer 19 of the 25 questions correctly to pass.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You must answer 19 out of the 25 questions correctly to pass the test.

rules.text: The test is timed and any question left unanswered in the prescribed time is counted incorrect.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: There is a time limit on the test and any questions not answered in the prescribed time will be considered incorrect.

rules.text: Automated testing is given at all locations.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Automated testing is given at all locations.

rules.text: Audio versions are available for the reading impaired, administered with headphones.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Audio versions of the knowledge examination are available for the reading impaired.  The test is administered with headphones.

rules.text: The same rules apply to the audio version, and DMV staff may not read or re-word the test for you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Employees of the DMV are not to read the test to you, re-word the information, or provide additional help explaining questions that would not be supplied to applicants taking the printed knowledge exam.

plainEnglish: The knowledge examination is at least 25 questions, and every one of them comes from this handbook — basic knowledge, traffic rules, regulations, signs and markings. You need 19 of 25 right, which means six wrong answers is the most you can afford. The test is timed, and this is the part people underestimate: anything you have not answered when time runs out is marked wrong, so a question you skip to come back to costs you exactly as much as one you got wrong. An audio version with headphones exists for the reading impaired, and the same rules apply to it — DMV staff are not permitted to read the test to you, re-word it, or explain a question in any way they would not explain it to someone reading the printed exam.
whyItMatters: Knowing the pass mark changes how you study. Nineteen of 25 is a 76 percent threshold with no partial credit and no negotiation, and because unanswered questions count as wrong, the practical advice is to answer everything before the clock runs out rather than leaving blanks.
example: With two minutes left you have four questions untouched because you were saving them. If the clock beats you, all four score as incorrect — combined with two you already missed, that is six wrong and a failed test even though you knew the material on at least some of them.

title: The Vehicle You Bring to the Test

rules.text: The vehicle is checked for compliance with registration, inspection and equipment laws before the test.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The testing vehicle must first be checked to make sure it complies with registration, vehicle inspection and equipment laws.  A valid inspection sticker and proof of insurance on the vehicle is required before the vehicle can be used for the road skills test.

rules.text: Vehicle defects may constitute failure of examination.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Vehicle defects may constitute failure of examination.

rules.text: A minor defect may be corrected and the examination continued, but not in a different vehicle on the same date.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: you will not be permitted to continue the examination in another vehicle on the same test date

rules.text: You must be able to locate and demonstrate all vehicle safety equipment, including the parking/emergency brake.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The applicant must know the location and function of all safety equipment, including the parking/emergency brake.  If the applicant is unable to both locate and demonstrate the use of any of the vehicle safety equipment, this will result in an automatic failure on the road skills test.

rules.text: Windows tinted to less than 35 percent light transmission are illegal equipment.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Windows tinted to less than 35 percent light transmission

rules.text: Red and/or blue flashing lights are reserved for authorized emergency vehicles.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Red and/or blue flashing lights (Only authorized emergency vehicles may have these warning lights)

rules.text: A broken or cracked windshield is listed as illegal equipment.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A broken/cracked windshield

plainEnglish: The test starts before you drive anywhere. The examiner checks that the car is registered, inspected, insured and legally equipped, and defects in it can fail the examination outright. Bring a car with a cracked windshield, a dead brake light, tint below 35 percent light transmission or a broken door, and you may not get out of the parking space. If a defect is minor the examiner may let you fix it and carry on — but you cannot go and fetch a different car and continue on the same day. You also have to know the vehicle: being unable to both find and demonstrate any piece of safety equipment, the parking brake included, is an automatic failure.
whyItMatters: This is the most avoidable failure in the whole process, and the one most often suffered in a borrowed car. Fifteen minutes finding the hazard lights, the defroster and the parking brake in the vehicle you will actually test in removes the risk entirely.
example: You borrow your uncle's car for the test and cannot find the rear defroster switch when the examiner asks. That alone is an automatic failure on the road skills test, before you have driven a metre — and you cannot swap to your mother's car and continue that day.

title: What the Examiner Is Scoring

rules.text: The road test is not given until you have passed all other parts of the knowledge examination.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The road test, or driving examination, will not be given until you have passed all other parts of the knowledge examination.

rules.text: Adjust the seat and rear view mirror before driving, because proper seat adjustment assures better control.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Adjust the vehicle seat and rear view mirror before driving.  Proper seat  adjustment assures better control of the vehicle.

rules.text: Keep both hands on the steering wheel and do not rest your elbow in the window.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Keep both hands on the steering wheel and do not rest your elbow in the window.

rules.text: You may be tested on a subset of the basic control skills exercises, including parallel parking and turnabouts.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: How To Prepare For Your Driver's Test
source.sourceQuote: During the test, you may be tested on a subset of the following Basic Control Skills exercises:

rules.text: Each failure to use, or improper use of, a turn signal counts as an error.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: How To Prepare For Your Driver's Test
source.sourceQuote: Each time you fail to use or improperly use your turn signal it will count as an error.

rules.text: Points are deducted if you do not use head and traffic checks during all portions of the driving test.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: How To Prepare For Your Driver's Test
source.sourceQuote: Points will  be deducted if you do not use head/traffic checks during all positions of the driving test.

rules.text: A safe stopping gap behind another vehicle lets you see that vehicle's rear tires.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A safe gap when stopping behind another vehicle is to stop where you can see the rear tires of the vehicle ahead of you.

rules.text: You will be asked to identify traffic signs, which can be anywhere on the route.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: During the road test you will be asked to identify a number of traffic signs.  They can be located anywhere on the road test.

plainEnglish: The road test comes only after the knowledge examination is passed. Once you are in the car, the examiner is watching a short list of habits over and over: signals used correctly and cancelled afterwards, head checks over the shoulder before every lane change and turn, both hands on the wheel, smooth braking, and a proper gap when you stop behind someone — close enough to be in traffic, far enough back to see their rear tires. Set the seat and mirror before you move, because the handbook ties seat position directly to vehicle control. Expect to be asked what a sign you just passed meant, at any point on the route.
whyItMatters: Most road test points are lost on repetition, not on one dramatic error. A signal missed on four separate manoeuvres is four errors, and the handbook says so explicitly. Treating signals and head checks as automatic, every single time, is what separates a pass from a near miss.
example: You change lanes smoothly, but you check only your mirror and never look over your shoulder. Nothing goes wrong and no other car is near. You still lose points, because the handbook scores the head check itself, not just the outcome.

title: Automatic Failures, and What Happens If You Fail

rules.text: Hitting, tapping or moving a cone, barrel or flag is an automatic failure.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Hitting, tapping, or moving a cone, barrel, or flag

rules.text: Jumping a curb during any part of the driving test is an automatic failure.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Jumping curb during any part of the driving test

rules.text: Not using your safety belt disqualifies you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If you do not use your safety belt

rules.text: Using your wireless communications device at any time disqualifies you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If at anytime you use your wireless communications device

rules.text: The examiner having to take control of the vehicle disqualifies you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If the examiner has to take control of the vehicle

rules.text: Failing to wear your glasses if required disqualifies you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If you fail to wear your glasses if required

rules.text: Failing to yield to pedestrians or other roadway users disqualifies you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If you do not yield to pedestrians or other roadway users

rules.text: Applicants who fail the knowledge or road skills test may not be tested twice within one week.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Applicants who fail either the knowledge or road skills test may not be tested twice within a period of one (1) week, in accordance with §17B-2-6, West Virginia State Code.

rules.text: All first-time applicants complete a short DUI awareness course given on passing the road skills test.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The DMV requires that all first-time applicants for a driver's license or motorcycle-only West Virginia driver's license complete a short DUI awareness course given upon passing the road skills test.

plainEnglish: Some errors are not scored, they simply end the test. Touching a cone, barrel or flag. Putting a wheel over a curb. Driving without your belt. Touching your phone at any point. Failing to yield to a pedestrian or another road user. Being caught without the glasses your licence requires. And if the examiner ever has to take the wheel or the brake, the test is over. If you do fail — knowledge or road — the handbook bars a second attempt within one week, so a bad day costs you at least seven days before you can try again. Pass the road test as a first-time applicant and you will complete a short DUI awareness course on the spot.
whyItMatters: Knowing which errors are automatic changes your priorities on test day. A hesitant three-point turn is recoverable; reaching for a buzzing phone is not. And because the retest rule blocks a second attempt inside a week, there is no value in going in unprepared to 'see what it's like'.
example: Halfway through the test your phone buzzes in the cupholder and you glance at it and swipe it away. That is use of a wireless communications device during the test, which disqualifies you outright — and you cannot retest for a week. Leaving the phone switched off in the glovebox removes the temptation entirely.

title: What Makes Interstate Driving Different

rules.text: Interstates have largely removed head-on collisions, but driving on them is very different.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Interstate and divided highways have largely removed the chance of head-on collisions, but driving on interstates is very different.

rules.text: Safe use of interstates demands complete awareness of high-speed driving and constant alertness.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Safe use of interstates demand a complete awareness of  high-speed driving and constant alertness by the driver.

rules.text: Slower traffic should drive in the right-hand lane except when passing.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Slower traffic should drive in the right-hand lane, except when passing.

rules.text: Trucks and buses entering the interstate may need extra time to adjust to traffic patterns.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Remember that trucks and buses entering the interstate may need extra time to adjust to traffic patterns.

rules.text: Even-numbered interstates run east to west.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Even-numbered interstates run east to west.

rules.text: Odd-numbered interstates run north to south.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Odd-numbered interstates run north to south.

rules.text: A three-digit number beginning with an even digit is a beltway or bypass; an odd first digit marks a spur route.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Three-digit numbers with an even first number identify beltways or bypasses around cities.

rules.text: Plan your route in advance and check gas, water, oil and tires, including the spare, before you leave.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Since interstate entrances and exits are sometimes far apart, it is important to plan your route in advance.  Make sure your vehicle is in good working condition.

rules.text: The first guide sign for an interchange is placed well in advance so you can change lanes and exit smoothly.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: On interstates, the first guide sign for an interchange is placed well in advance of the point where you must turn off.  This permits ample time to change lanes and exit smoothly.

plainEnglish: An interstate removes the single most dangerous thing about a two-lane road — oncoming traffic — and replaces it with speed. Everything you do has to happen earlier and be planned further ahead. Slower traffic belongs in the right-hand lane, leaving the left for passing. The numbers themselves are a map: even numbers run east-west, odd numbers run north-south, and a three-digit number tells you whether you are on a beltway around a city (even first digit) or a spur into one (odd first digit). Because entrances and exits can be far apart, a missed turn is expensive, so plan the route and check the car — gas, water, oil and tires including the spare — before you set off.
whyItMatters: The number system is genuinely useful rather than trivia: it tells a lost driver which way they are heading and whether the road they are joining goes around a city or into it. And the right-lane habit is the one that keeps the passing lane clear, which is what makes high-speed traffic flow safely.
example: You see a sign for I-470 and wonder where it goes. Three digits with an even first digit means a beltway or bypass around a city — so it will take you around the built-up area rather than through it, while the two-digit route it branches from carries on.

title: Getting On: the Ramp, the Gap and the Merge

rules.text: You enter an interstate by using an entrance ramp, paying careful attention to the signs.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You enter an interstate by using an entrance ramp.  Make sure you pay careful attention to the signs.

rules.text: An exit ramp is often next to the entrance ramp, marked with Do Not Enter and Wrong Way signs.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Often, an exit ramp will be next to the entrance ramp, marked with “Do Not Enter” and “Wrong Way” signs.

rules.text: Look for advisory speed limit signs on the ramp; they are used where the ramp curves sharply.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Look for any advisory speed limit signs on the ramp.  These are used if the ramp curves sharply.

rules.text: About halfway along the entrance ramp, start the merging steps.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: About halfway on the entrance ramp, start taking these steps:

rules.text: Check interstate traffic with quick glances over your shoulder and to the side.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Take quick glances over your shoulder and to the side.

rules.text: Find a gap in the approaching traffic and adjust your speed to meet that gap.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Adjust your speed to meet that gap.

rules.text: Do not stop on the ramp or the acceleration lane.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Do not stop on the ramp or acceleration lane.

rules.text: If no gap is available it may be necessary to use the shoulder beyond the acceleration lane and stop — a last resort.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: it may be necessary to drive onto the shoulder beyond the end of the acceleration lane and stop

rules.text: You cannot always count on other drivers seeing you or making room for you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You cannot always count on other drivers seeing you or moving over to give you room to enter.

plainEnglish: Merging is a timing problem, and the handbook solves it by telling you when to start: about halfway along the entrance ramp. From that point you are checking interstate traffic with quick glances over your shoulder and to the side, signalling, picking a gap, and adjusting your speed to meet that gap — so that when the acceleration lane runs out you are already travelling at the speed of the traffic you are joining. Follow the lane and merge; do not cut sharply left across it. Never stop on the ramp or the acceleration lane, because a stopped car there is a hazard and rejoining from a standstill is far harder. If there genuinely is no gap, the shoulder beyond the acceleration lane is a last resort, not a plan.
whyItMatters: Traffic already on the interstate has the right-of-way, and the handbook adds the sentence that should change how you merge: you cannot always count on other drivers seeing you or moving over. Merging is your problem to solve, using speed and position, not something the traffic owes you.
example: You are halfway down the ramp and the lane beside you is solid with a truck alongside. Rather than braking on the ramp, you ease off slightly, let the truck pass, pick the gap behind it, and accelerate hard into it so you arrive at highway speed. Stopping at the end of the ramp would have left you trying to reach 65 mph from a standstill with traffic bearing down.

title: Getting Off, and Where You May Not Stop

rules.text: Signal and move into the exit lane well before the exit; last-moment lane changes risk the exit or a crash.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Signal and move into the lane well before you have to exit.  Changing lanes at the last moment risks missing your exit or causing a crash.

rules.text: Most exits have a deceleration lane; never slow down on the interstate itself.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Most interstate exits have a special lane for you to slow down in before you reach the exit ramp.  Never slow down on the interstate.

rules.text: Wait until you are in the deceleration lane, then brake gently to the posted exit ramp limit.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Wait until you are in the deceleration lane, then brake gently until your speed matches the posted exit ramp limit.

rules.text: Shoulders are only for disabled vehicles, not for changing drivers or reading a map.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Shoulders on interstates are to be used only for disabled vehicles.  Do not use the shoulders for changing drivers, reading a map, or other non emergency purposes.

rules.text: Do not stop in an exit gore — a driver who missed the exit may cross it and strike you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Do not stop in an exit gore (the triangular area between the through lane and the exit ramp).

rules.text: No parking is permitted on interstate shoulders, and parked vehicles may be towed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: No parking is permitted on the shoulders of interstates.  Parked vehicles may be towed.

rules.text: Never make a U-turn on an interstate; go to the next exit to turn around.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You should never make a U-turn on an interstate.  Go to the next exit to turn around before re-entering the interstate.

rules.text: The gravel or paved median crossovers are for police and emergency vehicles only.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The gravel or paved crossovers in the medians of some highways are to be used only by police and emergency vehicles.

plainEnglish: Exiting is the mirror image of merging: you get into position early and you shed speed in the right place. Signal and move into the exit lane well before the exit, then keep your speed until you are actually in the deceleration lane and brake gently there to the posted ramp speed. Slowing on the interstate itself puts you far below the traffic behind you, which is exactly the hazard the chapter warns about. Stopping is tightly limited. Shoulders are for disabled vehicles — not for swapping drivers or checking a map — and parked vehicles may be towed. The exit gore, the triangle between the through lane and the ramp, is the worst place of all to stop, because that is the strip a driver who just missed the exit may cut across.
whyItMatters: Missing an exit tempts drivers into the two most dangerous responses available: braking hard in a live lane, or turning around. The handbook closes both doors — never slow down on the interstate, never make a U-turn, go on to the next exit. Accepting a few extra minutes is the whole lesson.
example: You realise at the last second that your exit is here. The right answer is to keep going to the next exit and come back. Braking in the through lane, swerving across the gore, or stopping on the shoulder to think are each specifically what this section rules out.

title: Speed, Weather, Breakdowns and Work Zones

rules.text: Never drive faster than the legal speed limit, and always drive at a steady speed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You should never drive faster than the legal speed limit.

rules.text: Do not drive slower than 55 mph unless weather or road conditions are bad or a lower speed is posted.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Do not drive slower than 55 mph on an interstate unless the weather or road conditions are bad or a lower speed has been posted.

rules.text: Driving much slower than other drivers creates a hazard, because others may change lanes abruptly.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: When you drive on interstates at a speed much slower than other  drivers, you create a hazard.

rules.text: Headlights must be on during adverse conditions, under §17C-15-2 of the West Virginia State Code.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: In accordance with §17C-15-2 of the West Virginia State Code, headlights must be turned on during adverse conditions.

rules.text: In adverse conditions maintain adequate following distance and adjust speed to allow a safe stop.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: It is especially important to maintain an  adequate following distance and adjust your speed to ensure the possibility of a safe stop.

rules.text: If disabled, move well off the road, use four-way flashers, and get everyone out and away from the road.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If your vehicle  becomes disabled, move as far off the road as possible, turn on your four-way flashers to indicate your vehicle is stopped, and get everyone out of the vehicle and well away from the road.

rules.text: Place a flare about one vehicle length behind and another about 300 feet back, on the shoulder near the through lane edge.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Put a flare about one (1) vehicle length behind your vehicle and another about 300 feet back.

rules.text: In very dense fog it may be better to leave the interstate and use slower roads.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If the fog is very dense, it may be better to leave the interstate and use the slower roads to reach your destination.

rules.text: When a lane is closed, signs are posted well in advance — move over as soon as possible.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If a lane is closed, signs will be posted well in advance.  You should move over to the open lane as soon as possible.  Avoid waiting until the last minute to change lanes.

plainEnglish: An interstate has a floor as well as a ceiling. You never exceed the posted limit, but you also do not drop below 55 mph unless the weather or road conditions are bad or a lower speed is posted, because a car moving far slower than the traffic around it forces other drivers into abrupt lane changes. When conditions turn, the handbook is specific: headlights on, following distance up, speed down enough that a safe stop is actually possible. In very dense fog, the best answer may be to leave the interstate entirely. If you break down, get the car as far off the road as you can, put on the four-way flashers, and get everyone out and well away from the traffic — flares go one vehicle length back and about 300 feet back. In work zones, move over as soon as you see the lane closure signs rather than running to the merge point.
whyItMatters: The minimum-speed rule surprises people, but it follows from the same logic as everything else in this chapter: on an interstate the danger comes from differences in speed, not from speed itself. And the breakdown instruction to get everyone out of the vehicle runs against most people's instinct to sit and wait inside.
example: A tire goes flat at 65 mph. You ease onto the shoulder as far right as you can, put on the four-way flashers, and everyone gets out on the passenger side and moves well away from the road up the bank. Sitting in the car on the shoulder while traffic passes at 70 mph is exactly what the handbook tells you not to do.

title: The Habits That Cause Crashes

rules.text: Bad driving habits result from laziness, impatience, inattention, arrogance and aggressiveness.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Bad driving habits result from laziness, impatience, inattention,

rules.text: Always turn your head and look behind you before changing lanes, pulling out, or getting out on the traffic side.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Always turn your head and look behind you

rules.text: Come to a complete stop at a stop sign or red light regardless of traffic, even when turning right.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: a complete stop at a stop sign or red light,

plainEnglish: The handbook names five specific habits: laziness, impatience, inattention, arrogance and aggressiveness. Laziness is checking only the mirror instead of turning your head, and not bothering to signal. Impatience is rolling a stop sign because nothing is coming and someone is behind you. Inattention is letting your grip and your focus loosen until the car wanders with your mind. Arrogance is treating the car as an extension of your ego.
whyItMatters: None of these are dramatic. They are all small, comfortable shortcuts that feel harmless every time you take them, which is exactly why they turn into habits. The handbook's point is that you have to notice them in yourself and correct them deliberately.
example: You approach a red light intending to turn right. Nothing is coming and the car behind is close. Slowing to 5 mph and rolling through feels safe and considerate. It is still a failure to stop, and it is the habit that will eventually meet a pedestrian stepping off the kerb you did not check for.

title: Seeing and Being Seen

rules.text: Dim your headlight beams within 500 feet of an oncoming vehicle, and within 200 feet of a vehicle you are following.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: dim your headlight beams within 500

rules.text: Turn on headlights, not just parking lights, when it begins to get dark or whenever visibility may be impaired.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: It is the law and a good idea to turn on your headlights, not just your parking

rules.text: Overdriving your headlights means driving too fast to stop within the distance they light.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: means driving too fast to stop safely within the distance clearly lit by your

plainEnglish: Two numbers matter here and they are easy to mix up: 500 feet when you are meeting someone head-on, 200 feet when you are behind them. The bigger distance goes with the bigger risk — blinding an oncoming driver puts two cars in danger. Overdriving your headlights is the subtler idea: if your lights show 200 feet of road but you need 250 feet to stop, you are driving into a space you cannot see.
whyItMatters: At night your stopping distance does not shrink, but your seeing distance does. Most drivers never adjust speed for that. And if oncoming headlights do catch you, the handbook's instruction is specific: slow down, keep right, and look at the right edge of the road rather than into the lights.
example: On an unlit road at 55 mph you meet a car. You dim at about a football field and a half away, and as it passes you fix your eyes on the white line at the right edge rather than the glare, so you keep your lane and your night vision.

title: Rain, Ice, Fog and Standing Water

rules.text: Partial hydroplaning begins at about 35 mph; at 55 mph tires can ride entirely on top of the water with no friction to brake, accelerate or corner.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: partial hydroplaning occurs on the road at about 35 mph.

rules.text: Never attempt to drive across a flooded roadway. Six inches of water can float a small vehicle; two feet will carry most away.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: As little as six (6) inches of water can float some smaller vehicles, while two

rules.text: In fog or dense smoke, reduce speed and use low-beam headlights.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Use your low-beam headlights.

plainEnglish: Rain is most dangerous when it starts, because oil and dirt lift off the surface into a slippery film before the rain washes it away. As speed rises, the tires stop cutting through water and start riding on it — around 35 mph partially, and by 55 mph potentially not touching the road at all. When that happens you have no braking, no acceleration and no steering. In fog, low beams are correct: high beams reflect off the fog straight back at you.
whyItMatters: Flooded roads deserve their own warning. Nearly half of all flash flood deaths in the United States are motorists trapped in vehicles, and in many cases the road itself has already washed away under the water. Six inches is less than the depth of a kerb.
example: A back road has water running across it after a storm. It looks shallow. You cannot see the surface underneath, you do not know whether the road is still there, and six inches is enough to float the car. You turn around.

title: Is the Car Fit, and Are You?

rules.text: West Virginia requires an inspection of all vehicles every two years, and it is against the law to remove the inspection sticker.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: West Virginia requires an

rules.text: On a long trip take a 10-minute rest break at least every two hours, spent outside the vehicle.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: take a 10-minute rest break at least every two (2) hours.

rules.text: Gain self control over anger, worry or fear before driving.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: control these emotions and gain self control before driving.

plainEnglish: The handbook's line is blunt: you cannot safely drive 10 feet or 10 miles in an unsafe vehicle. West Virginia backs that with a two-yearly inspection and a windscreen sticker you are not allowed to remove. On the driver's side, the four conditions named are fatigue, alcohol, emotional state, and defective eyesight or hearing — and fatigue gets a specific remedy: stop every two hours for ten minutes, out of the car.
whyItMatters: Emotional state is the one people dismiss. Driving straight after a row, in tears or in a rage, is treated by the handbook as a condition affecting safe operation in the same list as alcohol and fatigue.
example: Three hours into a drive you notice you have stopped checking mirrors and cannot remember the last few miles. That is the point the handbook's two-hour rule was meant to catch. You pull in, get out, walk around for ten minutes.

title: Six Ways Another Vehicle Can Put You in a Crash

rules.text: Assume the vehicle ahead may stop suddenly and without warning; keep a safe following distance.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: the vehicle ahead of you may stop suddenly and without

rules.text: Do not treat being passed as a challenge. Slow down and keep as far right as practical.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: slow down, and keep as close to the right side of the road as possible, making

rules.text: Exceeding the speed limit when passing is illegal.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Exceeding the speed limit when passing is

plainEnglish: The handbook lists six positions another vehicle can be in before a crash: ahead of you, tailgating you, oncoming, at an angle, passing you, and being passed by you. Each has its own defence. The one people get wrong most often is being passed — treating it as a challenge instead of easing off and letting it happen causes sideswipes and run-off-road crashes.
whyItMatters: Note the handbook's test for passing: if you have to speed to pass, you probably do not need to pass. Exceeding the limit to overtake is illegal, so a pass that only works above the limit is not a legal pass.
example: Someone comes up fast behind you on a two-lane road and pulls out to pass. Rather than holding your speed, you ease off slightly and move right within your lane, which shortens the time they spend on the wrong side of the road.

title: Safety Belts and Child Seats

rules.text: Everyone in a passenger vehicle must wear a federally approved safety belt, and it is the driver's responsibility to see that they do.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Safety Belts - It is the Law
source.sourceQuote: It is the responsibility of the driver to ensure that all passengers are buckled into their

rules.text: The only legal exception is a person 18 years or older riding in the back seat.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Safety Belts - It is the Law
source.sourceQuote: The only legal exception is for persons 18 years or older who are riding in the back

rules.text: A child under 8 must be in a federally approved child safety device, unless the child is at least 4 feet 9 inches tall, in which case a safety belt is sufficient.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: safety device system meeting applicable federal motor vehicle safety standards

plainEnglish: In West Virginia everybody in a passenger vehicle wears a belt, and the driver — not each passenger — is the one held responsible for it. There is exactly one exception: an adult of 18 or over sitting in the back. Everyone else, front or back, adult or child, must be buckled. Children under 8 need a proper child safety seat rather than just a belt, unless they have already reached 4 feet 9 inches, at which point a normal belt fits them correctly and is enough.
whyItMatters: The handbook puts a number on it: belts cut the chance of injury or death in a collision by 45 to 50 percent. They work by spreading crash forces across the strongest parts of the body and keeping you from being thrown forward or out of the vehicle. A belt worn wrongly — lap belt up on the soft stomach instead of low across the hips — gives away much of that protection.
example: You are driving two friends. One is 19 and sits in the back; the other is 17 and sits in front. Legally the 19-year-old in the back is the single permitted exception, but the 17-year-old must be belted — and if they are not, it is you the driver who is responsible.

title: Read the Shape Before You Read the Words

rules.text: An eight-sided (octagon) sign is always a stop sign, and it means stop completely and give the right-of-way to pedestrians and all cross traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: These eight-sided signs are reserved for stop signs.  These signs mean you must stop completely. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and to all cross traffi  c before moving again.

rules.text: Stop behind the marked or unmarked crosswalk; with no markings, stop before entering the intersection.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: At a stop sign, you must stop behind any marked or unmarked crosswalk (joining sidewalks on opposite sides of the street).  If there are no pavement markings or cross walks, you must stop before entering an intersection.

rules.text: Stop where you can see traffic coming from all directions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Stop at a place where you can see traffi  c coming from all directions.

rules.text: An upside-down triangle means yield the right-of-way to cross traffic or merging traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Single Message Shaped Signs - Triangle (upside down)
source.sourceQuote: This shape requires that you yield the right-of-way to cross traffi  c or to merging traffi  c.

rules.text: A pennant marks the beginning of a no-passing zone.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: This sign marks the beginning of a no-passing zone.

rules.text: A round yellow-and-black sign gives advance warning of a railroad crossing ahead.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: This yellow-and-black sign gives advance warning of a railroad crossing ahead.

rules.text: A pentagon warns of a school zone ahead or marks a school crossing, where the limit is 15 m.p.h. when children are present or when specified.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The maximum speed limit in a school zone is 15 m.p.h. when children are present or when specifi ed.

rules.text: A right-side-up triangle with a reflective red border and fluorescent orange centre marks a slow moving vehicle or one that has made an emergency stop.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Single Message Shaped Signs - Triangle (right side up)
source.sourceQuote: A right side up triangular sign with a refl ective red border and fl uorescent orange center identifi es a slow moving vehicle or a vehicle which has made an emergency stop.

rules.text: Shape and colour carry meaning so a sign can be recognised when light, fog, rain, snow or darkness hide the letters.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The shape and color of signs have meaning.  If fading light, fog, rain, snow, or darkness make it diffi  cult to see the letters, applicants should still know how to recognize a sign and respond accordingly.

plainEnglish: West Virginia reserves a unique outline for each of a handful of critical messages. Octagon is stop, upside-down triangle is yield, pennant is no passing, circle is a railroad warning, pentagon is a school zone, and an upright orange triangle is a slow vehicle. Nothing else uses those shapes.
whyItMatters: On a foggy night or behind a salt-crusted windscreen the lettering may be unreadable long before the outline is. The handbook expects you to identify and obey the sign from its silhouette alone, and permit tests lean heavily on shape-to-meaning recall.
example: You crest a hill at dusk in heavy rain and can only make out a five-sided outline at the roadside. Without reading a word you should already be braking toward 15 m.p.h. and scanning for children, because only a school zone sign is a pentagon.

title: Regulatory Signs Tell You the Law

rules.text: Square and rectangular signs show traffic regulations and guide your speed and direction.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: These signs show traffi  c regulations and guide your speed and direction. These signs tell you about speed limits and other traffi  c laws.

rules.text: Most signs are white with black letters; when the message is very important the sign is red with white letters.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Most signs are white with black letters. When the message is very important, the sign is red with white letters.

rules.text: A red outline with a diagonal bar through it always means NO.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A red outline with a diagonal bar through it always means “NO.”

rules.text: Speed limit signs show the fastest speed you may drive under optimal weather and road conditions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: These signs show the fastest speed you may drive under

rules.text: Advisory speed signs at interstate entrance and exit ramps are black on yellow.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: These advisory signs are black on yellow.

plainEnglish: Squares and rectangles carry the rules. White with black letters is the everyday regulatory sign; red with white letters is reserved for the messages that matter most; and any red circle with a slash through it forbids whatever is drawn inside.
whyItMatters: Regulatory signs are enforceable law, not advice. Confusing a black-on-yellow advisory speed with a posted white-and-black limit, or missing a red slash, is how drivers pick up citations they thought they were obeying.
example: A white rectangle reads SPEED LIMIT 55 on a dry clear day, but the ramp ahead carries a black-on-yellow 35. The 55 is the law for the highway under ideal conditions; the 35 is the recommended safe speed for the curve of the ramp, and taking the ramp at 55 is exactly how vehicles roll over.

title: Yellow Diamonds Warn You Early

rules.text: Diamond-shaped warning signs usually appear without explanatory words beneath them, are yellow with black letters, and warn of possible danger ahead.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: These  diamond-shaped signs will usually appear without  explanatory words beneath them.  These signs are yellow with black letters.  They warn of possible danger ahead and may have symbols or written warnings.

rules.text: Pedestrian and school warning signs may be yellow-green with black letters.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Pedestrian and school warning signs may be yellow-green with black letters.

rules.text: Most warning signs are seen without identifying text and instead often have pictures.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The shapes and colors of signs are a very helpful indicator as to what they are trying to tell you.

plainEnglish: A yellow diamond says something ahead needs your attention: a curve, a crossroad, a merging lane, a hill, a low bridge, a slippery stretch, a crosswalk or a signal. The symbol tells you which. Pedestrian and school warnings may use a brighter yellow-green.
whyItMatters: Warning signs are placed far enough ahead that you can still act. A driver who registers the diamond but does not slow until they see the hazard has already given away the margin the sign was designed to buy.
example: A yellow diamond with a squiggly arrow appears on a rural road you have never driven. There is no advisory plate, so you have no number to obey — but the sign is telling you that the curve cannot be taken at the regular highway speed, so you come off the accelerator before you enter it.

title: Orange Means People Are Working

rules.text: Construction and maintenance signs notify drivers of unusual or potentially dangerous conditions in or near work areas.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Construction and maintenance signs are used to notify drivers of unusual or potentially dangerous conditions in or near work areas.

rules.text: The commonly used work-zone devices are signs, barricades, drums, cones, tubes, flashing arrow panels and flaggers, and orange is their basic colour.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Construction and Maintenance Signs and Devices
source.sourceQuote: The most commonly used traffi  c control devices are signs, barricades, drums, cones, tubes, fl ashing arrow panels, and fl aggers.  Orange is the basic color for these devices.

rules.text: Large flashing or sequencing arrow panels guide drivers into certain lanes and tell them part of the road ahead is closed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Construction and Maintenance Signs - Flashing Arrow Panels
source.sourceQuote: Large fl ashing or sequencing arrow panels may be used in work zones both day and night to guide drivers into certain traffi  c lanes and to inform them that part of the road or street ahead of them is closed.

rules.text: Flaggers wear orange vests, shirts or jackets and use red-orange flags or stop/slow paddles to direct traffic through work zones.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Flaggers wear orange vests, shirts, or jackets and use red-orange fl ags or stop/slow paddles to direct traffi  c through work zones.

plainEnglish: In a work zone the colour changes from yellow to orange, and the devices change from signs alone to barricades, drums, cones, arrow panels and people. A flagger's paddle carries the same authority as a sign.
whyItMatters: Work zones put people on foot a few feet from live traffic, and the layout can change between one trip and the next. The orange colour is your cue that what you learned about this stretch of road yesterday may not be true today.
example: A flashing arrow panel points left half a mile ahead of a lane closure, and a flagger in an orange vest holds a SLOW paddle. You move left early rather than running the closing lane to its end, and you pass the flagger at a speed that would let you stop for a worker stepping out.

title: Guide Signs Answer Where and How Far

rules.text: Guide signs tell you where you are, what road you are on, and how to get where you want to go.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: These signs tell you WHERE you are, WHAT road you are on, and HOW to get where you want to go.

rules.text: Most guide signs are white on green, motorist services signs are white on blue, and park and recreation signs are white on brown.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Most guide signs are white on green. Motorist services signs are white on blue.   Signs for parks and public recreation areas are white on brown.

rules.text: WV and U.S. route markers are generally black on white.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: WV & U.S. Route Markers - Are generally black on white.

rules.text: Interstate markers are red, white and blue.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Interstate markers -  Are red, white, and blue..

plainEnglish: Green is navigation, blue is services such as fuel and food, brown is parks and recreation. Route markers identify the road itself: black on white for WV and U.S. routes, red white and blue for interstates.
whyItMatters: Reading guide signs early is what keeps you from a last-second lane change across three lanes at an exit — the manoeuvre that causes crashes at interchanges. The colour tells you instantly whether a sign is worth reading now or not at all.
example: Approaching an interchange you see a green sign for EXIT 99 in one mile and a blue sign listing fuel. The green sign decides your lane; the blue one only decides whether you take the exit at all, so you read the green sign first and move right while there is still room.

title: At a Crossing, the Train Always Wins

rules.text: Railroad crossing signs may be round or diamond-shaped yellow signs with black symbols, or black letters on white bars in the shape of an X called a crossbuck.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Railroad crossing signs can be round or diamond shaped, yellow with black symbols, or  black letters on white bars in the shape of an X called a crossbuck.

rules.text: A sign below the crossbuck indicates the number of tracks when there are two or more.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A sign below the crossbuck indicates the number of tracks when there are two

rules.text: You must yield to all trains, and failure to stop when lights are flashing or a barrier is down will result in a citation.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You must yield to all trains.  Failure to stop when lights are fl ashing, or a barrier is down, will result in a citation.

rules.text: Where there are two or more tracks, be alert for a second train on the other set of tracks.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: When there are two (2) or more tracks, you must be alert for a second train on the other set of tracks.

rules.text: Do not enter a crossing until the vehicle ahead has moved far enough that you can clear the tracks, or you may be trapped and hit.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: you should not enter a railroad crossing until the vehicle ahead has moved far enough ahead that you can clear the tracks.  Otherwise, you may be trapped on the tracks and hit by another vehicle or by a train.

rules.text: Passing is prohibited within 100 feet of any railroad crossing.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Passing is PROHIBITED in the following places
source.sourceQuote: Within 100 feet of any railroad crossing.

rules.text: Do not change lanes at a railroad crossing.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: DO NOT change lanes in an intersection or at a railroad crossing.

plainEnglish: The crossbuck is the crossing itself; the round yellow sign is the advance warning. Bells, flashers and gates mean a train is coming, and you must yield to every train, every time. Never move onto the tracks unless there is room for your whole vehicle on the far side.
whyItMatters: A train cannot stop for you and needs far more distance than any road vehicle. Most crossing deaths involve a vehicle that was on the tracks with nowhere to go, either because traffic ahead had not cleared or because the driver assumed only one train was coming.
example: Traffic is backed up beyond a crossing at rush hour. The car ahead moves forward but stops with its bumper only two car-lengths past the far rail. You hold behind the crossbuck rather than following it, because if the queue does not move you would be sitting on the rails when the gates come down.

title: Every Signal Indication Has One Meaning

rules.text: On circular green you may enter the intersection and go straight, right or left unless other devices prohibit the movement.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Drivers facing this signal may enter the intersection and go straight through, turn right, or left, unless, other traffi  c control devices (signs or pavement markings) prohibit certain movements.

rules.text: A driver facing circular green who wishes to turn left must yield to oncoming vehicles.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A driver who is facing a circular green indication and wishes to turn left must yield to oncoming vehicles.

rules.text: A green arrow lets you enter the intersection to make the movement shown by the arrow.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A green arrow may be shown alone or with other indications.  Drivers facing the signal may enter the intersection to make the movement shown by the arrow.

rules.text: A green arrow in a left-turn signal usually means opposing traffic is stopped.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: When the green arrow is shown in a left-turn signal, it usually means that opposing traffi  c is stopped.

rules.text: Steady yellow means the green is ending; only drive through it if the vehicle clearance is within the intersection.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: This means that the green light is ending and will change to red.  You should only drive through a yellow light if the vehicle clearance is within the intersection.

rules.text: A yellow arrow means the green arrow is ending and will change to red.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Yellow Arrow / LEFT TURN - This means that the green arrow is ending and will change to red.

rules.text: Traffic facing steady circular red must stop and remain stopped until another indication allows it to proceed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Traffi  c facing a steady circular red signal must stop unless making a movement permitted by a green arrow.  The driver must remain stopped until allowed to proceed by another indication.

rules.text: Right on red is allowed at two-way streets and left on red from one-way to one-way, after yielding to all traffic and pedestrians and if no sign prohibits it.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A driver may turn right on red at the intersection of two-way streets, or may turn left on red from a one-way street to another one-way street.  These turns may be made after yielding to all other traffi  c and pedestrians, and if no signs are posted to prohibit them.

rules.text: A steady red arrow requires a complete stop before the intersection, stop line or crosswalk, and you remain stopped while it is red.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Come to a complete stop before reaching the intersection, stop line or cross walk for the direction indicated by the arrow.  Remain stopped as long as the signal is red.

plainEnglish: Green is permission, not priority — you still yield when turning left. A green arrow is protection, because opposing traffic is normally stopped. Yellow means the phase is ending, and red means stop until something changes, with turn on red as the only exception.
whyItMatters: Intersections are where the most conflicting paths cross, and signal questions appear on every permit test. The difference between a permissive green ball and a protected green arrow is the difference between yielding and going, and getting it wrong causes head-on left-turn crashes.
example: You are waiting to turn left on a circular green with two cars coming the other way. The green ball does not give you the intersection — it only lets you into it — so you wait for a gap. If the signal changes to a green arrow, opposing traffic is stopped and the turn is yours.

title: Flashing Signals and Signals for People

rules.text: Flashers are installed at certain intersections to supplement or replace STOP signs.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: At certain intersections, fl ashers are installed to supplement or replace STOP signs.

rules.text: Drivers facing a circular flashing yellow may proceed through the intersection with caution.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Drivers facing a circular fl ashing yellow light may proceed through the intersection

rules.text: A circular flashing red is the same as a stop sign, so drivers must come to a complete stop and yield.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A circular fl ashing red is the same as a stop sign; that is, drivers must come to

rules.text: Signals that are not needed or are out of order may be placed in flashing operation, and then mean the same as intersection flashers.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: When traffi  c control signals are not needed or are out of order, they may be placed in fl ashing operations. When this happens, they are the same as intersection fl ashers.

rules.text: Lane use control signals control traffic where the direction of a street or lane changes during the day.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Special signals are used to control traffi  c when the direction of a street or certain lane changes during the day.  These signals indicate how the specifi c lanes may be used.

rules.text: Crosswalk signals are traffic signals for pedestrians, and pedestrians are to obey them.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Crosswalk signals are traffi  c signals for pedestrians.  If these signals are in place, pedestrians are to obey them.

rules.text: A hand symbol or DON'T WALK means pedestrians are not to cross.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Hand Symbol or DON'T WALK- when these appear pedestrians are not to cross the crosswalk.

rules.text: A walking man or WALK means pedestrians are safe to cross inside the crosswalk lines.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Walking Man or WALK - when these appear  pedestrians are safe to cross the street inside the crosswalk lines.

rules.text: A blind person using a guide dog, service animal, white cane or walking stick has the right-of-way whether or not they are in a crosswalk.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A blind person who is on foot and using a guide dog or other service animal, or is carrying a white cane or walking stick, has the right-of-way on a highway, street, or road regardless of whether they are in a crosswalk or not.

plainEnglish: Flashing red is a stop sign; flashing yellow is a caution. A dead or unneeded signal put into flashing operation means exactly the same thing. Pedestrian signals govern people on foot, but a blind pedestrian has the right-of-way regardless.
whyItMatters: A signal that has failed is one of the most dangerous intersections on the road, because drivers on each approach may be reading different indications. Knowing that flashing red equals a stop sign is what keeps a power cut from becoming a broadside collision.
example: A storm has knocked the signals at a four-way junction into flashing operation: red toward you, yellow across. You stop completely and yield as if at a stop sign, and you do not assume the cross traffic will stop — their flashing yellow lets them roll through with caution.

title: The Lines Are Instructions Too
